answer: 5 Day Komodo Island is a four-night voyage aboard Aliikai, a handcrafted phinisi, from Labuan Bajo through Indonesia's Komodo National Park: Sebayur, Gili Lawa, the mantas at Manta Point and Karang Makassar, the climb up Padar, Pink Beach, the Komodo dragons on Rinca and the flying foxes of Kalong at dusk. All meals, guided diving and snorkelling, kayaks and paddleboards are included. In 2027 it sails on 15 and 22 September, from US$3,400 per person plus 11% tax.
overview_title: Dragons, mantas and a pink beach, in five days
map_title: Four nights round Komodo National Park

days.title: Labuan Bajo to Sebayur
days.body: Welcome aboard in Labuan Bajo harbour, and out to the twin islands of Sebayur Besar and Sebayur Kecil. The rest of the day is for the water: dive or snorkel the reefs around the islands, a stretch on the beach, and a short trek if the tide allows. Dinner al fresco, under more stars than Labuan Bajo lets you see.
days.acts: Board · dive or snorkel · beach · trek
days.imgAlt: Labuan Bajo harbour, Flores, with boats at anchor in turquoise water

days.title: Gili Lawa
days.body: A whole day for Gili Lawa Darat and Gili Lawa Laut. After breakfast, ashore for the hike to the lookout and the view over the bay. The rest of the day is yours: beach, kayak, paddleboard, snorkel, or dive the sites around the islands. Lunch and dinner aboard.
days.imgAlt: The lookout over Gili Lawa's bay

days.title: Manta Point, Karang Makassar and Padar
days.body: The morning at Manta Point, snorkelling or diving with the mantas, then Karang Makassar, a sandbar in turquoise water. Lunch aboard as Aliikai sails to Padar. In the afternoon, the climb to the top of Padar for the view over its three bays, then time to snorkel or dive before dinner on deck.
days.imgAlt: Padar Island's ridges and crescent bays from the air

days.title: Pink Beach, Rinca and Kalong
days.body: Breakfast on deck, then ashore at Pink Beach for the sand, a kayak or paddleboard, and the reef just off it. Lunch aboard on the way to Rinca, where a park ranger briefs you and walks you out to see the Komodo dragons where they live. Back aboard for dinner and sundowners off Kalong, as the flying foxes leave the mangroves at dusk.

experiences.name: Komodo dragons on Rinca
experiences.body: After a briefing from a park ranger, a walk out to see the dragons in their own habitat. The rangers set the pace and the distance; you keep yours.
rows: Easy walk on uneven ground [confirm length]

experiences.name: Mantas at Manta Point
experiences.body: The morning in the channel with the mantas, by snorkel or on a dive, then on to the sandbar at Karang Makassar.

experiences.name: The Padar climb
experiences.body: The steps and path to the top of Padar, for the view over its three bays that the posters are taken from. Afternoon light, and steady shoes.

experiences.name: Pink Beach
experiences.body: Sand tinted pink by crushed red coral, with a reef close enough to swim to. Kayaks, paddleboards and dive gear come ashore with you.

vessel.title: Aliikai, in detail
vessel.name: Aliikai
vessel.blurb: A traditional phinisi hand-built and refitted in 2020 by more than a dozen carpenters in Bulukumba, South Sulawesi, where these boats have been built for centuries. Seven cabins over three decks, a lounge and dining room, a sky deck and an alfresco deck, with a crew of twelve and an expedition leader.

dep_season: Aliikai sails Komodo from May to September, in the dry season, then heads east for the Spice Islands and Raja Ampat. This four-night route sails on 15 and 22 September 2027; the other Komodo dates run three, five or six nights.
dep_note: Shared voyages are priced per person, double occupancy, plus 11% tax. Or charter the whole yacht (up to 15 guests): US$10,900 a night plus 11% tax, minimum 7 nights in Raja Ampat (3 in Komodo).

founder.title: I know the boat. This is her Komodo route.
founder.p1: James sailed Aliikai through Raja Ampat in November 2024. He hasn't sailed this Komodo route aboard her yet; the days on this page are Aliikai's own, checked against the 2027 schedule.
founder.p2: Four nights suits a first look at Komodo, or a few days at sea before or after Bali. A private charter can redraw the days around your group, from three nights in Komodo.

faqs: How much is a Komodo liveaboard aboard Aliikai?

From US$3,400 per person for 4 nights in an ocean-view cabin with portholes (2027 published rate, double occupancy), plus 11% tax. Deluxe ocean-view cabins with windows are US$3,960 and the owner's cabins with private balconies US$4,600. Meals, guided diving and snorkelling, water sports and Labuan Bajo transfers are included. Travelling solo, the single supplement is 50% of the nightly rate.
When is the best time to visit Komodo National Park?
Aliikai sails Komodo in the dry season, May to September. This four-night route sails on 15 and 22 September 2027; three-, five- and six-night Komodo voyages run from late May.
The route includes a ranger-led walk on Rinca to see the dragons in their own habitat. They are wild animals, so sightings are likely but never promised [confirm wording with the owner].
Can you snorkel with manta rays in Komodo?
Yes. Day 3 is spent at Manta Point, snorkelling or diving with the mantas, then the sandbar at Karang Makassar.
How do we get to Labuan Bajo?
Labuan Bajo, on Flores, is a short flight from Bali. The crew meets you and takes you to the boat, and back to the airport on the last morning.
Can we charter Aliikai privately in Komodo?
Yes. The whole yacht, for up to 15 guests, is US$10,900 a night plus 11% tax, with a minimum of 3 nights in Komodo.
